title: Every Block Needs a Friend
can_do: 朋友难过时先问感受、陪一会儿，再提议一起做点什么。

conversation_move.label: comfort a sad friend and suggest doing something together

trigger: Max's tower falls and he is sad, so Child comforts him and offers help.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: My tower fell down. All of it.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Oh no. Are you okay, Max?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: I'm fine, but my tower is ruined.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It was really tall. I saw you build it.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Now it's just a pile of blocks.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Tall towers can be built twice. Want to try together?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Every block needs a friend. Let's start with the base!

replay_cards.title: The lost marble
replay_cards.setting: Max loses his favorite marble at school.
replay_cards.change: He is quiet and sad all morning.
replay_cards.challenge: Child notices, asks, keeps him company, and offers to search the sand table together after snack.

replay_cards.title: The last runner
replay_cards.change: A classmate finishes last and tears up.
replay_cards.challenge: Child says something kind, names one thing the classmate did well, and walks to the water station with him.

parent_support: 同伴难过时别急着哄好或给建议，先让孩子陪着问一句“你还好吗”。
安慰的语言不用高级，“我在呢”“我帮你”就是最好的。
事后和孩子聊聊“朋友难过时可以做什么”，沉淀经验。
